title.narrative: Transparency and Accountability in Papua New Guinea Project (TAP Project)

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the project (impact) is to contribute to improve transparency and accountability in the use of public financial resources at the national level in Papa New Guinea (PNG), and particularly in the Autonomous Region of Bougainville

The outcomes are:

1-Increased demand for Integrity, Transparency and Accountability (ITA) systems and practices on a national level;

2- Improved ITA systems and practices at the pilot subnational level (in Bougainville).
